speech.register: Unhurried, kind conversational English. Busy hands and practical observations accompany calm, firm boundaries. Rest and asking for care become ordinary personal needs.
speech.stage_relaxation: Matter-of-fact treatment opens into barracks childhood, guild work, difficult choices when medicine runs short, and admitting her habit of postponing her own needs.
speech.extension: Extend established boundaries and voluntary requests without adding canonical facts for unspecified stages.
